title: Define A2A retry idempotency policy
summary: Define the idempotency metadata and operator policy required before automatic A2A retry can be implemented.
expectedFailureModes: Automatic retry work begins before task classes can declare duplicate safety.
Requeue policy hides duplicate-work risk from operators.
Docs imply retries are safe while only manual repair is implemented.
nextAction: Write the A2A idempotency policy and convert automatic retry into concrete implementation tasks.
